question: Which of the following is an artificial sweetener?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saccharin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An artificial sweetener is a chemical compound produced synthetically as a substitute for natural sugar.
